title: Kestrum
controls_hint: Choose New Game to unfold the atlas. Use Full Screen for the best view.
about: A world waiting for its history. Kestrum is a generational strategy game about kingdoms, armies, and the places their stories leave behind.

Begin a Rosemarch campaign with founding armies and officers. Recruit into six formation slots, move groups along physical routes, split armies and transfer co-located troops or people. Inspect route costs, remaining movement and supply before confirmation. Manage owned places to found Outposts with real settlers, improve roads, build Forts and add recruitment facilities. Work keeps its progress through interruptions, with visible costs, builders and cancellation refunds. Each full round grants income, pays upkeep, restores eligible supplied formations and keeps a separate checkpoint. Save named copies, browse past moments and retry failed saves. Hostile field encounters resolve automatically with persistent casualties, retreats and wounds. Meaningful service earns Seasoned and Veteran formations. Menu > Records opens battle reports, searchable known people and filtered histories. Enemy details remain dated to actual encounters. Defended forts become persistent sieges. Choose assault, maintenance, withdrawal, sortie or escape, and bring outside armies through a joint relief battle. Rival kingdoms currently pass.

controls.desc: Select marked places and inspect their control, supply and connections
Inspect regional sites and return to the previous world camera
Dismiss the selected place's inspector
Inspect your six-slot rosters, resources, leadership, supply and last round's economy
Open an owned place's work orders, population, facilities, Build, Roads and Focus
Review the prepaid cost, duration and builder; inspect an order to Replace Builder or confirm cancellation
Choose a troop type, review its cost and requirements, then Confirm Recruit
Select your participating armies, choose Assault, Maintain, Withdraw, Sortie or Escape, inspect the risk and Confirm Siege Order
Move an outside army to your besieged site; Review Route explains the joint battle and fallback before Confirm Move
Move Army, transfer the selected formation, open People, inspect recovery or disband with confirmation
Select co-located armies, Choose Destination on the map, inspect Review Route and Confirm Move
Menu > Records opens known people, places, armies and battle reports; Search offers a touch keyboard, Events and Filters page recorded history
Inspect earned formation XP and personal evidence from army, people and place controls; enemy links show last encountered facts
Choose a co-located recipient; transfers preserve spent movement and remain available during paused rival phases
Pan the map with one finger or the left mouse button
Zoom the map; a mouse wheel also works
Return to the full atlas
Finish your faction's orders; a full round advances one season and saves
Pause between rival orders, advance one phase, or resume progress
Page through saves, load a selected moment, or confirm an overwrite or deletion
Name a separate copy with the visible keyboard; physical typing is optional
Recover from a failed save without repeating completed orders
Open saving, loading, settings, help, and the title screen; Escape also opens the menu
